The supplied heading has no State 2 text, so its agreement with the changed context and its compliance with SPEC_STANDARD §15.3.1 cannot be reviewed.
options: Supply the complete text of all five named units for review.
Declare the five units intentionally empty, leaving no State 2 requirements in them.
open_points.default_guess: Do not continue or infer the missing rules; request the complete State 2 text.

open_points.subject: ConfirmedOwnerAction correspondence
open_points.text:
`ConfirmedOwnerAction`, the row of the data provider's
`CONFIRMED_OWNER_ACTIONS`, is one: its two fields name the confirmed action
(M20, M31) and the owner action (M27), and the rule the table serves — an
action that asks for confirmation is submitted with the confirmation value
the step showed — is fixed by State 2 A13 rule 6 and the `ConfirmedAction`
vocabulary, the closed list of the actions that ask for confirmation
("Identity formats"). It has no model number here.
open_points.question: Must `CONFIRMED_OWNER_ACTIONS` contain exactly one row for every `ConfirmedAction`, and which `OwnerAction` is paired with each member?
options: Define a total, unique correspondence with one execution action for every `ConfirmedAction`.
Allow a partial correspondence, making some confirmed actions unavailable for submission.
Allow multiple owner actions for a confirmed action and specify how the consumer chooses among them.
open_points.default_guess: Use exactly one row per `ConfirmedAction`, paired with the owner action that executes that same confirmed operation.
consequences: Every confirmation offered by the product has one unambiguous submission action.
A confirmation step may be shown but have no contract-defined action capable of submitting it.
The same confirmation may select different operations unless an additional selection rule is defined.
open_points.requirement: an action that asks for confirmation is submitted with the confirmation value the step showed

witness.initial: An owner session has shown confirmation for archiving an active project and holds the one-time confirmation value.
events: The owner submits the shown confirmation value.
The generated owner-interface contract consults `CONFIRMED_OWNER_ACTIONS` to determine the owner action.
outcomes: A unique archive owner action is selected and the confirmed archive is submitted.
The archive mapping is absent or non-unique, so submission is refused or a different owner action is selected.
witness.observer: The owner sees whether the confirmed archive succeeds, is unavailable, or invokes another action.
